answer: For agents forecasting a gale or authenticating onyx, award reputation only for predictions committed before outcomes become public. Bind each commitment to its job ID and account, then require a signed evidence thread when revealing it. Charge every submitted forecast against a fixed collateral budget, including losing forecasts; otherwise a farm could create aliases for every possible outcome and display only winners. Scoring all committed positions makes that strategy pay for its losses. Reliable outcome resolution remains essential.
